suppressPackageStartupMessages({

  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
})
# Clean data: drop rows with NA log2FC or pvalue
diff_clean <- diff_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue) & pvalue > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    log10p = -log10(pvalue),
    sig = case_when(

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
})
# Re-create cleaned data
diff_df <- readxl::read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx") %>% as.data.frame()
diff_clean <- diff_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange) & !is.na(pvalue) & pvalue > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    log10p = -log10(pvalue),
    sig = case_when(
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Up",
      pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    sig = factor(sig, levels = c("NS", "Down", "Up"))
  )
# Thresholds
fc_cut <- 1
p_cut <- 0.05
y_cut <- -log10(p_cut)
# Pick top genes to label: top 10 by |log10p|*|log2FC| within significant group
diff_clean <- diff_clean %>%
  mutate(rank_score = ifelse(sig == "NS", 0, abs(log2FoldChange) * log10p))
top_up   <- diff_clean %>% filter(sig == "Up")   %>% arrange(desc(rank_score)) %>% head(10)
top_down <- diff_clean %>% filter(sig == "Down") %>% arrange(desc(rank_score)) %>% head(10)
top_labelled <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
cat("Top Up:\n");   print(top_up$id)
cat("Top Down:\n"); print(top_down$id)
# Build diagonal threshold segments
# Two diagonal lines: from (fc_cut, y_cut) to (max(log2FC), y_cut + (max(log2FC)-fc_cut)) on the right
# and from (-fc_cut, y_cut) to (min(log2FC), y_cut + (min(log2FC)+fc_cut)) on the left
xmax <- max(diff_clean$log2FoldChange)
xmin <- min(diff_clean$log2FoldChange)
ymax <- max(diff_clean$log10p)
diag_right <- data.frame(x = c(fc_cut, xmax), y = c(y_cut, y_cut + (xmax - fc_cut)))
diag_left  <- data.frame(x = c(-fc_cut, xmin), y = c(y_cut, y_cut + (-xmin - fc_cut)))
p <- ggplot(diff_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = log10p)) +
  # diagonal significance cutoff lines
  geom_line(data = diag_right, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = diag_left,  aes(x = x, y = y), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # points: NS first (background), Down/Up on top
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_clean, sig == "NS"), color = "grey70", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_clean, sig == "Down"), color = "#3B7DB8", size = 1.0, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_clean, sig == "Up"),   color = "#D9472B", size = 1.0, alpha = 0.85) +
  # vertical/horizontal cutoffs
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_cut, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # label top genes
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labelled,
    aes(label = id),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 12, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot — group2 vs group1",
    subtitle = sprintf("|log2FC| > %g and p < %g   |   n = %d genes   |   Up = %d, Down = %d",
                       fc_cut, p_cut,
                       nrow(diff_clean),
                       sum(diff_clean$sig == "Up"),
                       sum(diff_clean$sig == "Down")),
    x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change (group2 vs group1)"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 220)
cat("Saved: diagonal_volcano.png\n")
cat("Size:", file.size("diagonal_volcano.png"), "bytes\n")

ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 220)
cat("Saved:", file.size("diagonal_volcano.png"), "bytes\n")
# Also save the differential table with classification for reference
saveRDS(diff_clean, "diff_clean.rds")
write.csv(diff_clean, "diagonal_volcano_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

diag_left  <- data.frame(x = c(-fc_cut, xmin), y = c(y_cut, y_cut + (-xmin - fc_cut)))
# Use English title for portable PNG rendering
p <- ggplot(diff_clean, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = log10p)) +
  geom_line(data = diag_right, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = diag_left,  aes(x = x, y = y), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_clean, sig == "NS"),   color = "grey70", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_clean, sig == "Down"), color = "#3B7DB8", size = 1.0, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = subset(diff_clean, sig == "Up"),   color = "#D9472B", size = 1.0, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_cut, color = "grey40", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labelled,
    aes(label = id),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 40,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-12, 12, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot (group2 vs group1)",
    subtitle = sprintf("|log2FC| > %g and p < %g   |   n = %d genes   |   Up = %d, Down = %d",
                       fc_cut, p_cut, nrow(diff_clean),
                       sum(diff_clean$sig == "Up"), sum(diff_clean$sig == "Down")),
    x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 220)
cat("Saved:", file.size("diagonal_volcano.png"), "bytes\n")
